friction.interpretation: Native measured Coulomb utilization/saturation observer; not independently reimplemented.

interpretation.numerical: Fingerprint continuity, source-range checks, dimensions, and momentum/contact impulse reconciliation are numeric/runtime evidence.
interpretation.plausibility: Support force, drift, friction, and penetration are observed mechanics; they alone do not establish human biomechanical validity or clinical realism.

loaded_metal_runtime.scope: Loaded MetalRobo image path and unchanged file hash; source and shader identities remain separate bindings

scope: Offline accepted-state and contact audit of completed native 909; no simulation or source/assets modified.

source_joint_map.range_comparison: Direct against source_range using the 9-significant-digit serialized accepted q text, without added tolerance.

support_and_momentum.observer_scope: The native label is per_step_delta_p_minus_gravity_and_contact_only; this is not a complete all-force closure test.
support_and_momentum.window: Force/impulse steps 5001..10000 ([10,20] s); COM endpoint states step 5000 and 10000.
